mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Pick an object to extract, or write your own query

options.tooltip: Guided mode extracts one object with the fields you pick, over the date range you set. Raw mode runs a GraphQL query you write yourself and always loads everything.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Optional extra filter, written as JSON

options.tooltip: A filter tree in JSON, AND-joined with the date range. Example: `{"fieldIds": ["e_creationdate"], "gte": "2026-01-01"}`. Leave empty for no extra filtering.

documentation.tooltip: Filter grammar in the service's own documentation
